heading: ASKO Essence 60cm Pyrolytic Oven - Black Glass
productFeatures: Precise temperature control,  3″ TFT display, Connectivity with associated ConnectLife app, Air Fry functionality, Auto Programmes, Multi-functional tray for versatile cooking
shortDesc:
Elevate everyday cooking with ASKO's new Essence Oven. Featuring a sleek black glass finish, it brings a refined, contemporary look to your kitchen while delivering the performance you need for exceptional results at home.

Using the ConnectLife app, you can unlock the full potential of ASKO’s CelsiusºCooking™ technology. Combined with the oven’s unique calibrating system and precise temperature control, it delivers consistent, professional-level heat to help you achieve beautifully cooked dishes – whether you’re baking, roasting, or grilling. The intuitive touch control display offers seamless access to cooking functions, settings and automatic programs, making it simple to select the perfect option for any meal.

For added convenience, the pyrolytic self-cleaning function heats the oven to a high temperature, turning food residue into ash that can easily be wiped away.

Combining elegant design with precise cooking performance, the Essence Oven is crafted to make everyday cooking effortless.
webCopy: This ASKO Essence Series 2 Combined Microwave Oven pairs the convenience of a microwave with fan-forced oven and grill functions. Celsius°Cooking technology, intuitive controls and an easy-to-use touch display give you a practical and elegant appliance that suits most Australian kitchens. Handle weekday meals and weekend feasts with this all-black glass oven.
